meta.name: business-contact-social-links-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users automatically extract official website and social media profiles. Agent should proactively apply this skill when users express needs like search for official website and social media contacts of a company, find YouTube and LinkedIn profiles by company name, extract social media links from a specific website URL, discover a company's X and Facebook presence, gather business contact details using their brand name, retrieve TikTok and Instagram links from a target website, track competitor social media strategy, extract multi-platform social links for lead generation, find official contact channels of local businesses, collect canonical profile URLs for outreach campaigns, or build a contact database from Yellow Pages leads.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动提取公司官网和社交媒体链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取企业官方联系渠道和社媒账号。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically extract official websites and social media profiles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to collect official contact channels and social media accounts for businesses.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的公司名或网址，自动搜索并提取该公司的官网和社交媒体链接（如 LinkedIn、Facebook、X/Twitter、Instagram、YouTube、TikTok）。
howto.when: 当你要求查找某公司的官网和社交媒体账号，或提供网址要求提取其中的社交链接时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 OpenAI 的官网和社交媒体账号。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并返回官网及社交链接。

say.text: 提取这个网址里的所有社交链接：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会爬取该页面并列出社交平台链接。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can automatically search and extract the official website and social media links (e.g., LinkedIn, Facebook, X/Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) based on a company name or website URL you provide.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find a company's official website and social media accounts, or provide a URL to extract social links from it.

say_en.text: Find the official website and social media accounts of OpenAI.
say_en.note: Claude will search and return the links.

say_en.text: Extract all social links from this URL: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude will scrape the page and list the social platform links.
